content.title: Star New Build
content.lead: Brand-new, low-maintenance and finished the way a builder would want it done.
paragraphs: A new-construction townhome in Star with clean modern lines, an attached garage and a flex room that works as an office or guest space.
With a low-maintenance yard and a builder warranty, it suits buyers who want a modern home without the project list.
